key_insight: The paper shows that high-order IMEX-BDFk finite element schemes can stably and accurately solve incompressible Navier-Stokes flow without requiring a CFL-type time-step restriction.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical, high-order time integration strategy for CFD and fluid-structure-related simulations where stability, accuracy, and mesh-independent time stepping are important.
method: IMEX-BDFk time stepping for k=1 to 6
Explicit treatment of nonlinear convection; implicit treatment of the linear Stokes operator
Taylor-Hood finite elements for spatial discretization
evidence_signal: The authors prove stability, uniform boundedness, and optimal error estimates, and report numerical experiments that confirm the predicted convergence rates up to sixth order.
watch_item: The scheme’s efficiency and robustness depend on careful implementation of high-order IMEX-BDF steps and compatible Taylor-Hood discretization, especially in 3D problems.
paper_title: Stability and error analysis of IMEX-BDFk finite element schemes for the incompressible Navier-Stokes system
